Smittie 的 FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1 和 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 工作流程

描述

通过此工作流程，您可以使用 FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1 或 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 编辑图像。它保持简单且结构良好。

安装说明

1. 通过 ComfyUI Manager 安装所有缺少的自定义节点

2.下载所有需要的模型

扩散模型

原文：FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1-transformer.safetensors

推荐：FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1_fp8mixed_comfy.safetensors

闪电LoRA

FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0-Lightning-8steps-v1.0.safetensors

文本编码器

qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

VAE

qwen_image_vae.safetensors

致谢

大部分功劳归于 Qwen、FireRed、ComfyUI 和 CivitAI 团队，以及 kijai、Firetheft 和 cocorang。谢谢你们！

Smittie's FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1 and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 Workflow

Description

With this workflow you can edit images using FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1 or Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. It is kept simple and well structured.

Install Instructions

1. Install all missing custom nodes via the ComfyUI Manager

2. Download all needed models

Diffusion model

Original:FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1-transformer.safetensors

Recommended:FireRed-Image-Edit-1.1_fp8mixed_comfy.safetensors

Lightning LoRA

FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0-Lightning-8steps-v1.0.safetensors

Text encoder

qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

VAE

qwen_image_vae.safetensors

Acknowledgement

Most credits goes to the Qwen, FireRed, ComfyUI and CivitAI team, as well as kijai, Firetheft and cocorang. Thank you guys!
